project_type: Node.js/Express backend + React frontend with Material-UI, attendance management system
build_system: npm workspaces with separate backend and frontend directories
test_framework: Jest for backend (npm test), no frontend test suite found
build_command: npm run build (backend echoes completion message, frontend would use standard React build)
verification_instructions: Backend: Start server with 'npm run dev' in backend directory on port 5050. Frontend: Start with 'npm start' in frontend directory on port 3000. Test via browser or API client.
environment_constraints: Backend runs on port 5050. MongoDB connection required. Frontend connects to backend via api/axios configured base URL. No restart of dev servers required for this task.
contribution_requirements: No explicit CONTRIBUTING.md or AGENTS.md found. Follow existing code patterns and conventions. Maintain middleware chains for auth/authorization. Use existing ExcelJS and MUI component patterns.
key_patterns: Backend controllers use async/await with try/catch, return JSON errors with 4xx/5xx status codes. Routes use middleware arrays for auth. Frontend components use React hooks (useState, useEffect, useCallback), Material-UI components, and axios for API calls with responseType:'blob' for file downloads. Export pattern: fetch blob, create URL, programmatic anchor click, revoke URL.
directory_structure: Root contains backend/ and frontend/ subdirectories. Backend: controllers/, routes/, models/, middleware/, services/, utils/. Frontend: src/pages/, src/components/, src/api/, src/utils/. FEAT artifacts and plans go in .agents/tasks/ at workspace root (never inside worktree).
